title: Building classification and use
content: Northstar Building A is a commercial office workplace, not a residential building. Its ten occupied floors contain tenant offices, shared amenities, reception, and building operations spaces.
source: Northstar Building A Property Profile · Building classification · revised August 2026

title: Fitness center operating hours
content: The Building Alpha fitness center is open Monday through Friday from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and weekends from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Access requires an active tenant badge.
source: Building Alpha Tenant Handbook · Amenities · revised August 2026

title: Loading dock deliveries
content: Loading dock deliveries require a reservation between 7:00 AM and 5:00 PM on weekdays.
source: Building Alpha Operations Manual · Deliveries · revised August 2026

title: Conference room comfort policy
content: Occupied conference rooms may be adjusted between 68°F and 75°F. Changes outside that range require facilities approval.
source: Building Alpha Energy and Comfort Policy · section 4.2

title: Visitor check-in
content: Visitors check in at the main lobby reception desk with photo identification. Their host receives an arrival notification and must confirm access before a temporary badge is issued.
source: Building Alpha Tenant Handbook · Visitors · revised August 2026

title: Mailroom package collection
content: The lobby mailroom is staffed on weekdays from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Occupants must show an active tenant badge when collecting a package.
source: Building Alpha Operations Manual · Mailroom · revised August 2026

title: Bicycle storage
content: Secure bicycle storage is located on parking level P1 and is available from 5:30 AM to 11:00 PM. Bicycle-room access must be enabled on the occupant's tenant badge.
source: Building Alpha Tenant Handbook · Commuter amenities · revised August 2026

title: Wellness room
content: The wellness room is Room 305 on Floor 3. It is available without a reservation when the occupancy indicator outside the room is green.
source: Building Alpha Tenant Handbook · Wellness · revised August 2026

title: Secure document recycling
content: Confidential documents must be placed in the locked blue consoles located beside each floor's service core. Facilities empties the consoles through the approved shredding vendor.
source: Building Alpha Operations Manual · Waste and recycling · revised August 2026
